correctness.rationale: For fixed P:V0->Vt-1 of rank r and independent uniform final B:Vt-1->V0, the product PB maps im(P) to itself and its restriction is uniform on End(im P), because the induced map Hom(im P,V0)->End(im P) is surjective with equal-size fibers. BP nilpotent iff PB nilpotent; Fine–Herstein gives probability q^{-r}, including r=0. Thus conditional P(BP nilpotent|P)=q^{-rank P}=q^{-n0}|ker P|. Each fixed nonzero starting vector survives t-1 independent uniform maps with probability s=prod_{i=1}^{t-1}(1-q^{-ni}); summing indicators gives E|ker P|=q^{n0}-(q^{n0}-1)s. Therefore for all finite q, t>=3, any positive rectangular dimensions, P(cyclic product nilpotent)=1-prod_{i=0}^{t-1}(1-q^{-ni}). The same proof actually includes t=1,2 but these are explicitly acknowledged as prior. Independent exhaustive product enumeration checked q=3,n=1,t=3: 19/27 and q=2,n=2,t=3: 37/64. Finite checks do not establish arbitrary dimensions; the kernel moment proof does.
